benefits.name: Fine Hotels + Resorts Credit
benefits.description: Statement credit toward prepaid Fine Hotels + Resorts bookings made through American Express Travel.

eligibleMerchants: Fine Hotels + Resorts via Amex Travel

benefits.terms: Up to $300 per half-year period ($600/year total). Prepaid bookings only, through American Express Travel. No enrollment required.

benefits.name: The Hotel Collection Credit
benefits.description: Statement credit per booking for prepaid stays of 2+ nights at The Hotel Collection properties booked through American Express Travel.

eligibleMerchants: The Hotel Collection via Amex Travel

benefits.terms: Requires minimum 2-night prepaid stay. No enrollment required. Not annual-capped in the same way as other credits — applies per qualifying booking, so no single renewalPeriod fits; treat as available whenever a qualifying booking is made.

benefits.name: Airline Fee Credit
benefits.description: Statement credit for incidental fees (checked bags, seat selection, in-flight refreshments, etc.) on one airline selected annually.
benefits.terms: Must select one qualifying airline per calendar year via the Amex account. Covers incidental fees only, not the cost of the ticket itself. No enrollment required beyond airline selection.

benefits.name: Uber Cash
benefits.description: Monthly Uber Cash credit for U.S. Uber rides and Uber Eats orders, with a bonus in December.
benefits.terms: $15/month ($20 in December) = $200/year total. U.S. only. Must add the Platinum Card to the Uber account as a payment method. Unused monthly amounts do not roll over.

benefits.name: Uber One Membership Credit
benefits.description: Statement credit covering an Uber One auto-renewing membership.
benefits.terms: Enrollment required. Covers an auto-renewing Uber One membership only.

benefits.name: CLEAR+ Credit
benefits.description: Statement credit covering a CLEAR Plus auto-renewing membership for expedited airport security.

benefits.name: Global Entry or TSA PreCheck Credit
benefits.description: Statement credit for a Global Entry (every 4 years) or TSA PreCheck (5-year membership) application fee.
benefits.terms: Global Entry credit is up to $120 (renews on the Global Entry's own ~4-year cycle); TSA PreCheck credit is up to $85 (5-year cycle). Enrollment required. Modeled here on the Global Entry cadence since it's the more commonly chosen option; verify against the actual chosen program's renewal date for a given cardholder.

benefits.name: Resy Dining Credit
benefits.description: Quarterly statement credit for dining at participating U.S. Resy restaurants.
benefits.terms: Up to $100 per quarter ($400/year total). Enrollment required. Restaurant must be a qualifying U.S. Resy partner.

benefits.name: Digital Entertainment Credit
benefits.description: Monthly statement credit for eligible streaming/media subscriptions.
benefits.terms: Up to $25/month ($300/year total). Enrollment required. Unused monthly amounts do not roll over.

benefits.name: Lululemon Credit
benefits.description: Quarterly statement credit for lululemon purchases.
benefits.terms: Up to $75 per quarter ($300/year total). Enrollment required. Excludes outlet locations.

benefits.name: Walmart+ Membership Credit
benefits.description: Monthly statement credit covering a Walmart+ auto-renewing membership.
benefits.terms: Enrollment required. Covers the monthly Walmart+ membership fee.

benefits.name: Global Lounge Collection
benefits.description: Access to over 1,550 airport lounges worldwide, including Centurion Lounges, Priority Pass lounges, and 10 annual Delta Sky Club visits when flying Delta.

loungeAccessDetail.guestPolicy: Varies by lounge network; Delta Sky Club limited to 10 visits/year and requires same-day Delta flight.

benefits.terms: Priority Pass requires separate enrollment through Amex. Delta Sky Club access requires flying on an eligible Delta-marketed/operated flight that day.

benefits.name: Marriott Bonvoy Gold Elite Status
benefits.description: Complimentary Marriott Bonvoy Gold Elite status, including space-available room upgrades.
benefits.terms: Enrollment is automatic/complimentary via linking Marriott Bonvoy account.

benefits.name: Hilton Honors Gold Status
benefits.description: Complimentary Hilton Honors Gold status: room upgrades when available, 80% bonus points, food/beverage credits at eligible properties, 5th night free on award stays.
benefits.terms: Complimentary enrollment required by linking a Hilton Honors account.

benefits.name: Car Rental Elite Status
benefits.description: Complimentary elite/premium status with Avis, Hertz, and National.
benefits.terms: Enrollment required through the American Express account.

benefits.name: Trip Delay Insurance
benefits.description: Reimbursement up to $500 per trip for reasonable expenses when a covered trip is delayed, up to 2 claims per 12 months.

benefits.name: Trip Cancellation & Interruption Insurance
benefits.description: Reimbursement up to $10,000 per trip and $20,000 per 12-month period for prepaid, non-refundable travel expenses.

benefits.name: Oura Ring Credit
benefits.description: Annual statement credit for an Oura Ring purchased directly from Ouraring.com.
benefits.terms: Enrollment required. Valid only for the ring itself purchased at Ouraring.com — not the Oura membership subscription, gift cards, accessories, or third-party retailers/marketplaces.

benefits.name: Equinox Credit
benefits.description: Annual statement credit toward Equinox memberships, including Equinox+.
benefits.terms: Enrollment required. Resets on the calendar year (Jan 1), not card anniversary. Applies to U.S. Equinox club memberships and Equinox+ digital subscriptions.

benefits.name: Car Rental Loss & Damage Insurance
benefits.description: Secondary coverage for damage or theft of most rental vehicles.
benefits.terms: Secondary coverage (not primary) — unlike Chase Sapphire Preferred's primary rental coverage.

earningRates.terms: Flights booked directly with airlines or through American Express Travel, up to $500,000 in purchases per calendar year, then 1x.
Prepaid hotel bookings made through American Express Travel.
